decisions.reason: The flat $10 royalty changes resale fees but does not alter which NFT state and entitlements transfer to the purchaser.
The secondary-sale royalty amount and type do not change the collection's unlimited-mint NFT ebook model.
The royalty decision does not require any change to the listed NFT metadata attributes.
The same-message FAQ introduction already records that secondary sales carry a clearly displayed flat $10 royalty, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The royalty amount does not change the Big Block prize parameters, and the source does not specify a new allocation of the $10 royalty to that pool.
The royalty amount does not change the Small Block prize parameters, and the source does not specify a new allocation of the $10 royalty to that pool.
A flat secondary-sale royalty does not alter the winners-page one-click prize claim flow.
The secondary-sale royalty is independent of the $5 commission triggered by a referral-code primary mint.
The secondary-sale royalty amount and type do not change the Chainlink VRF winner-selection method.
This Requirement governs primary-mint pricing and allocation; the flat $10 secondary royalty does not change its current primary-sale values.
The royalty decision does not change ticket issuance from qualifying referral mints or the rule that secondary sales generate no tickets.
The secondary-sale royalty amount and type do not affect badge milestones or on-chain badge recording.
